tasks.title: Setup Development Environment and Infrastructure
tasks.description: Set up the development environment with required dependencies and establish the initial project structure for both frontend and backend components.
tasks.details: Install and configure Node.js 18+, Rust 1.75+, PostgreSQL 15+, Redis 7+, Docker, and Kubernetes. Create project repositories for frontend (TypeScript/React) and backend (Rust). Set up basic project structure with proper configuration files (package.json, Cargo.toml, tsconfig.json, etc.). Configure linting and formatting tools. Create initial Docker configurations for local development.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify all dependencies are correctly installed and configured. Ensure Docker containers can be built and run locally. Create automated environment validation scripts to confirm all required tools are available and properly configured.

tasks.title: Implement CI/CD Pipeline
tasks.description: Create a comprehensive CI/CD pipeline for automated testing, building, and deployment of both frontend and backend components.
tasks.details: Set up CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions or GitLab CI. Configure build pipelines for TypeScript frontend and Rust backend. Implement automated testing in the pipeline. Set up staging and production deployment workflows. Configure Kubernetes deployment manifests. Implement infrastructure-as-code using Terraform or similar tool. Set up monitoring and alerting with Prometheus and Grafana.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that code changes trigger the pipeline correctly. Ensure tests run automatically on pull requests. Confirm successful builds deploy to staging environment. Test rollback capabilities. Validate monitoring dashboards are capturing system metrics.

tasks.title: Implement Core Backend Infrastructure in Rust
tasks.description: Develop the foundational backend infrastructure using Rust with Actix-web or Axum framework, including database connectivity and basic API structure.
tasks.details: Set up Rust backend project with Actix-web or Axum. Implement database connectivity using SQLx or Diesel with PostgreSQL. Create database migration system. Implement basic API structure with health check endpoints. Set up error handling middleware. Configure logging with tracing crate. Implement basic request validation using Serde. Set up Docker configuration for the backend service.
tasks.testStrategy: Write unit tests for all core components. Implement integration tests for database connectivity. Create API tests using Postman or similar tool. Perform load testing to establish baseline performance metrics. Validate Docker container functionality.

tasks.title: Implement Authentication and Authorization System
tasks.description: Develop a secure authentication and authorization system using JWT and OAuth2 with role-based access control.
tasks.details: Implement JWT-based authentication in Rust backend. Set up OAuth2 provider integration. Create user management API endpoints. Implement role-based access control (RBAC) system. Set up secure password hashing using argon2. Implement token refresh mechanism. Create middleware for route protection. Set up audit logging for authentication events. Ensure HIPAA compliance for authentication processes.
tasks.testStrategy: Perform security testing including penetration testing. Write unit tests for authentication logic. Create integration tests for the entire auth flow. Validate token generation and verification. Test role-based access restrictions. Verify audit logging captures all required events.

tasks.title: Port Core Business Logic to Rust
tasks.description: Migrate the existing Java-based business logic to Rust, focusing on the analytics engine and workflow orchestration.
tasks.details: Analyze existing Java codebase to identify core business logic. Implement equivalent functionality in Rust. Port workflow orchestration logic (replacing jBPM). Implement the analytics engine using Rayon for parallel processing. Set up data validation using Serde. Optimize memory management for performance. Implement unit tests for all business logic. Create benchmarks to compare performance with the original Java implementation.
tasks.testStrategy: Create comprehensive test suite comparing outputs with the original Java system. Implement property-based testing for complex algorithms. Perform benchmarking to verify performance improvements. Conduct code reviews to ensure proper Rust idioms and patterns are followed. Test memory usage patterns under various loads.

subtasks.title: Analyze Java Codebase and Design Rust Architecture
subtasks.description: Analyze the existing Java business logic, identify core components, and design the Rust architecture for the port
subtasks.details:
1. Analyze the Java codebase to identify all core business logic components, focusing on the analytics engine and workflow orchestration
2. Document data structures, algorithms, and business rules that need to be ported
3. Create a mapping between Java classes/interfaces and equivalent Rust structs/traits
4. Design the Rust architecture, considering idiomatic Rust patterns (ownership, borrowing, etc.)
5. Define module structure and public APIs
6. Create a detailed plan for replacing jBPM with a Rust-based workflow orchestration system
7. Design data validation approach using Serde
8. Document memory management strategy for performance optimization
9. Testing approach: Create a test plan that maps Java tests to equivalent Rust tests, focusing on unit tests for core business logic

subtasks.title: Implement Core Analytics Engine in Rust with Rayon
subtasks.description: Port the analytics engine from Java to Rust, implementing parallel processing with Rayon and data validation with Serde
subtasks.details:
1. Implement the core data structures needed for the analytics engine in Rust
2. Set up Serde for data serialization/deserialization and validation
3. Implement the analytics algorithms in Rust, ensuring they match the Java implementation's behavior
4. Integrate Rayon for parallel processing capabilities
5. Implement memory optimization techniques as designed in subtask 1
6. Create utility functions for data transformation and processing
7. Implement error handling using Rust's Result type
8. Create benchmarking code to compare performance with Java implementation
9. Testing approach: Implement unit tests for each component of the analytics engine, create integration tests that verify the engine produces the same results as the Java version, and run benchmarks to measure performance improvements

subtasks.title: Implement Workflow Orchestration System in Rust
subtasks.description: Replace jBPM with a Rust-based workflow orchestration system that integrates with the analytics engine
subtasks.details:
1. Implement the workflow data models in Rust using structs and enums
2. Create a state machine to handle workflow transitions
3. Implement workflow persistence using Serde for serialization
4. Develop the orchestration logic to manage workflow execution
5. Create interfaces to integrate with the analytics engine from subtask 2
6. Implement event handling and callbacks for workflow state changes
7. Add monitoring and logging capabilities
8. Optimize for performance and memory usage
9. Testing approach: Create unit tests for individual workflow components, develop integration tests that verify complete workflow execution, test error handling and recovery scenarios, and benchmark against the original jBPM implementation

tasks.title: Implement Data Processing and Analytics Engine
tasks.description: Develop the Rust-based analytics engine with machine learning integration using tch-rs (PyTorch bindings).
tasks.details: Implement data processing pipelines in Rust. Set up parallel processing using Rayon. Integrate machine learning capabilities using tch-rs (PyTorch bindings). Implement data transformation and normalization functions. Create analytics API endpoints. Set up caching layer using Redis for improved performance. Implement batch processing capabilities. Ensure proper error handling and recovery mechanisms.
tasks.testStrategy: Create benchmark tests comparing performance with original system. Implement unit tests for all analytics functions. Test with large datasets to verify scalability. Validate machine learning model integration. Test cache hit/miss scenarios. Verify parallel processing efficiency under various loads.

tasks.title: Implement Healthcare Integration Features
tasks.description: Develop integration with OpenEMR and implement HL7 FHIR API support while ensuring HIPAA compliance.
tasks.details: Implement OpenEMR integration in Rust. Develop HL7 FHIR API support. Set up secure data exchange mechanisms. Implement data encryption at rest and in transit. Create comprehensive audit logging for all data access. Ensure HIPAA compliance throughout the integration layer. Implement error handling and retry mechanisms for integration failures. Create monitoring for integration health.
tasks.testStrategy: Test integration with OpenEMR test environment. Validate FHIR API compliance using standard test suites. Perform security testing on data exchange mechanisms. Verify encryption implementation. Test audit logging for completeness. Conduct HIPAA compliance review. Test error recovery scenarios.

tasks.title: Set Up Frontend Infrastructure with TypeScript/React
tasks.description: Create the foundation for the React frontend with TypeScript, including project structure, state management, and component library integration.
tasks.details: Set up React project with TypeScript. Configure Redux Toolkit for state management. Integrate Material-UI or Chakra UI component library. Set up React Hook Form for form handling. Configure routing using React Router. Implement API client with Axios or fetch. Set up authentication flow in the frontend. Create basic layout components. Implement responsive design foundation. Configure PWA capabilities.
tasks.testStrategy: Implement unit tests with Jest and React Testing Library. Set up component testing with Storybook. Create end-to-end tests using Cypress. Test responsive design across different screen sizes. Validate PWA functionality including offline capabilities. Test authentication flows.

tasks.title: Develop Core UI Components and Features
tasks.description: Implement the main UI components and features, including data visualization, forms, and user workflows.
tasks.details: Implement dashboard components. Create data visualization components using D3.js or Chart.js. Develop form components with validation. Implement user management interfaces. Create workflow visualization and management UI. Develop notification system. Implement search functionality. Create responsive layouts for all screen sizes. Implement theme switching capability. Ensure accessibility compliance.
tasks.testStrategy: Create visual regression tests for UI components. Implement user flow testing with Cypress. Conduct accessibility testing using axe or similar tools. Test data visualization with various datasets. Validate form validation logic. Test responsive behavior across devices. Conduct usability testing with representative users.

tasks.title: Perform System Integration, Testing, and Deployment
tasks.description: Integrate all system components, conduct comprehensive testing, and prepare for production deployment.
tasks.details: Integrate frontend and backend components. Implement end-to-end testing. Conduct performance testing and optimization. Perform security testing and vulnerability scanning. Implement data migration from the old system. Create production deployment configurations. Set up monitoring and alerting for production. Create disaster recovery procedures. Prepare user documentation and training materials. Implement feature flags for gradual rollout.
tasks.testStrategy: Conduct end-to-end testing of the entire system. Perform load testing to verify performance metrics. Execute security penetration testing. Validate data migration accuracy. Test monitoring and alerting systems. Conduct user acceptance testing. Perform disaster recovery drills. Verify all success metrics defined in the PRD are achieved.
